fullDescription: A professional and high-performance job board design system utilizing a sophisticated dark teal and blue palette. Optimized for recruitment platforms, SaaS dashboards, and career portals. Features a clean 'Satoshi' sans-serif typography, a dual-pane master-detail layout for desktop browsing, and an integrated search filter system. Key design motifs include glassmorphism filter pills, high-contrast action buttons in #1D4ED8, and status-specific badges in muted amber, emerald, and purple tints. The aesthetic combines a corporate dark mode header/hero with a light-mode data-rich content area for maximum readability.
prompt:
## Resumo
A sophisticated Job Board design system that uses a high-contrast transition from a deep teal hero section (#0B4764) to a clean, white-surface content area (#F8FAFC). It employs a master-detail split-pane view for job browsing, heavy use of micro-badges for categorization, and a search-focused hero section with subtle organic background shapes.

## Estilo Visual
Create a UI style guide based on a Professional Recruiting Platform. Typography: Use Satoshi sans-serif. H1: 48px/bold, H2: 24px/bold, Body: 14px/medium. Palette: Primary: #1D4ED8, Dark Teal: #0B4764, Darkest Navy: #0A2540, Surface: #F8FAFC, Border: #E2E8F0. Shadows: Subtle card shadow '0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)'. Components: Buttons should have 8px border-radius, 10px 24px padding. Inputs: Light grey background (#F1F5F9), 12px padding, transition to white bg with blue border (#93C5FD) on focus. Animation: Smooth 200ms ease-in-out transitions on hover for cards and buttons. Icons: Use Lucide-style line icons with 20px size and 1.5px stroke width.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header
A fixed-height navigation bar (72px) with #0B4764 background. Left side: Logo and text with 8px gap. Center: Horizontal nav links (Find jobs, Reviews, Salaries) in white/slate-300 with a 2px bottom border active state. Right side: Notification bell with a red dot indicator and a 36px circular avatar with a 1px border.

### Hero and Search
Full-width section with #0B4764 background and an organic, white-opacity (10%) abstract shape in the background. H1 headline is 48px, bold, white. Subtext is 18px, slate-300. The search bar is a white container (#FFFFFF) with 8px padding, containing two distinct input zones (Keyword and Location) separated by a vertical divider, and a primary blue button (#1D4ED8).

### Filter Bar
A horizontal row of pill-shaped buttons below the search bar. Each button has a semi-transparent white background (rgba(255,255,255,0.1)), 1px white/20 border, white text, and a chevron-down icon. Spacing between pills is 12px.

### Master-Detail Content
A 12-column grid with a 24px gap. Left Column (5 columns): A scrollable list of job cards. Each card is white, 20px padding, 12px radius, with a 1px border. Active cards get a 2px #1D4ED8 border. Right Column (7 columns): A sticky container (#FFFFFF) that matches the height of the viewport, containing deep-dive job information, including a call-to-action bar with 'Apply Now' (#1D4ED8) and 'Save' (Outline) buttons.

### Footer
Deep navy background (#0A2540). Four-column layout: Column 1 is a brand overview with a logo and an email signup input (bottom border only). Columns 2-4 are categorized link lists (For Seekers, For Employers, Resources) with 16px spacing between links. Bottom row features social icons in circular grey containers.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Interactive Job Card — Information-dense card with multiple metadata layers.
Card container: white bg, 1px #E2E8F0 border, 20px padding. Top row: 48px rounded-lg company logo placeholder, Job Title (18px bold), and 'Save Job' button (text + bookmark icon). Middle row: Match indicator (avatar + 'Your profile matches' text). Bottom row: Flex-wrap badges. Badges: 24px height, 12px px-padding, 999px radius, font-size 12px. Colors for badges: Amber-50 bg/Amber-700 text for 'Full Time', Blue-50/Blue-700 for 'Remote', Emerald-50/Emerald-700 for 'Senior'.

### Dual-Input Search Group — A refined search component that merges multiple inputs into a single visual unit.
White container, 12px radius, shadow-lg. Inside: Two flex-1 sections. Each section has a Lucide icon (#94A3B8), 12px gap, and an unstyled input field. A 1px vertical slate-200 divider sits between them. A final action area contains a 'Clear' text button and a #1D4ED8 'Search' button with 10px-24px padding.

style.description: The style is 'Corporate Modern' with a focus on trust and clarity. Typography uses Satoshi in weights 400 (regular), 500 (medium), and 700 (bold). Colors are anchored by primary blue (#1D4ED8) and deep teal (#0B4764). UI elements feature soft rounded corners (12px to 16px), subtle border treatments (#E2E8F0), and elevation-based shadows on hover. Status colors include Amber (#B45309 text on #FEF3C7 bg), Emerald (#047857 text on #D1FAE5 bg), and Blue (#1D4ED8 text on #DBEAFE bg).
